reader_summary.headline: What it right now is the best time and decades to start a company.
reader_summary.overview: What it right now is the best time and decades to start a company. In this episode, taken from Speedrun, a three month accelerator powered by A16Z designed to help founders move fast, Marc Andreessen joins Games. From the explosive rise of AI to shifting global policies.

key_points.evidence_quote: In this episode, taken from Speedrun, a three month accelerator powered by A16Z designed to help founders move fast, Marc Andreessen joins Games, general partner Jonathan Lai to make the case that we're entering a once in a generation window for builders.

key_points.text: From the explosive rise of AI to shifting global policies.
key_points.evidence_quote: From the explosive rise of AI to shifting global policies, Marc breaks down why the next four years presents a rare and urgent opportunity for founders and what separates the entrepreneurs who sees the moment from those who miss it.
